Version 8.19.18 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you[upgrade to this latest version](https://www.elastic.co/docs/deploy-manage/upgrade) . We recommend 8.19.18 over the previous versions 8.19.17


For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to[the release notes](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/starting-with-the-elasticsearch-platform-and-its-solutions/8.19/new.html) .
